shared.window: previous 200 bars [i-200, i), current bar excluded

primary.exit_rule: SHORT exits when z <= -0.25; LONG exits when z >= +0.25 (signed, same rolling z)
primary.stop_rule: SHORT exits when z >= +6.0; LONG when z <= -6.0

control.exit_rule: SHORT exits when z <= 0.0; LONG exits when z >= 0.0
control.stop_rule: SHORT exits when z >= +6.0; LONG when z <= -6.0

weighting: canonical TB-B exact-neutral: min ||q - q_alpha||^2 s.t. E q = 0, sum q = 1, q >= 0 (verify_tb_04a.exposure_matrix + tb_p6_anatomy.project_basket eps=0); sizes s = 3q; model weights are NOT MT5 lots
